name: Click Frames GD
description: Practice recording, verified timing windows and replay showcases at 240 TPS.

search-mode.name: Grouped window search
search-mode.description: Exact verifies every contiguous offset and is required for precise timing. Fast estimated is diagnostic: it skips interior probes, marks results ~ and excludes them from training and community exports.

dataset-mode.name: Dataset capture mode
dataset-mode.description: Forces exact search and at least a +/-12 tick radius. Only full-run, verified, collision-bounded rows enter dataset_entrenamiento.csv; open windows remain diagnostic.

precision-statistics.name: Export optional L* statistics
precision-statistics.description: Keeps the statistical model in separate CSV/report files; the live HUD always shows physical window milliseconds.

interval-hud.name: Show previous press interval
interval-hud.description: Optional separate interval HUD; this is elapsed time between presses, not window precision.

air-rejoin.name: Audited airborne reconvergence
air-rejoin.description: Stops after three exact matching airborne ticks with matching RNG/causal/physical/dynamic-world evidence. Sparse full-start audits guard against divergence; a mismatch clears local windows and disables shortcuts.

checkpoint-budget.name: Event checkpoint targets
checkpoint-budget.description: Targets checkpoints just before clicks on the reference run. Samples across the level if there are more targets than this. Object-state memory limits and fallback validation still apply.

scan-budget-ms.name: Analysis work budget per frame (ms)
scan-budget-ms.description: Up to 2048 recorded scheduler slices within this time budget per rendered frame.

precision-enabled.name: Window margin and hardest click (ms)
precision-enabled.description: Shows current window frames * 1000 / 240 and the smallest exact margin replayed this session. Independent of the optional L* solver. Open and estimated windows are labeled; Edit stays visual.

flight-recovery.name: Probe neighboring flight inputs
flight-recovery.description: After a failed flight boundary, tries the next input at -1/+1 tick. Saves alternative-route evidence in flight-recoveries.tsv without expanding fixed-macro windows.

batch-analysis.name: Batched analysis
batch-analysis.description: Replays recorded scheduler slices in bounded batches without drawing the hidden level between slices. Reference passes verify physical/causal parity. Budget is configurable; disable for mod conflicts.

marker-max-width.name: Largest circle window (frames)
marker-max-width.description: Hides circles and sounds above this width while retaining their measurements and counter totals. Set 41 to show every possible window.

local-analysis.name: Fast local segment analysis
local-analysis.description: Tests until the reference landing or the next relevant action's exit zone. Does not certify later consequences in the full run. Turn off for full-route margins. Changing scope restarts measurements when Analyze is pressed.

same-jump.name: Validate landing in full-run mode
same-jump.description: In full-run mode, cube/robot jumps must also match the reference landing corridor. Local mode always checks its own reference exit.

native-states.name: Validated native state cache
native-states.description: Captures event-directed checkpoints with dynamic-map/object-count limits, validates continuation physics up to the target event and tries earlier states on mismatch.

trajectory-preview.name: Analyzed trajectory preview
trajectory-preview.description: Show bounded traces from simulated candidates near their click during Play. Not live prediction for arbitrary manual inputs.

scan-speed.name: Analysis speed
scan-speed.description: Game speed while Verify/Analyze run behind a cover. 1.0 = normal. Lower it if your phone stutters.

max-rows.name: Max counter rows
max-rows.description: The counter shows every width from the smallest to the largest measured window, including empty widths. If there are more than this, the widest ones share one row (for example 8+).
